name: Tied
idea: The X of CNX is a red cord and a white cord bound together with a mărțișor twist, the same knot that closes a parcel.
why: Red-and-white twisted cord is the best-known good-luck sign in Moldova and Romania, and making it the X turns the name itself into something tied, sealed and delivered.
risks: The outlined cord is more illustrative than the flat C and N, the coil detail softens at 16 px, and the white strand depends on its navy outline on light backgrounds.
